newsitem.title: UK: Billy? No, I'm Primrose says stolen cockatoo.
newsitem.headline: Billy? No, I'm Primrose says stolen cockatoo.

text.p: A Briton was jailed for 15 months on Tuesday after a cockatoo he claimed was called Billy recognised its real owner and told police its name was in fact Primrose.
Police were not convinced that Billy was really Billy and took the Sulphur-crested bird, worth around 1,000 pounds ($1,561), to meet Sacha Hinds, who had had a cockatoo stolen from her pet shop.
It immediately said hello and stated its name as Primrose.
Clive McLoud, 40, was found guilty of one count of receiving stolen goods at Harrow Crown Court in north London.
